title: context: the compaction is a model call
intent: The compactor finds a cut point and writes a projection, and the projection is a projection: the source records stay on disk. But the summary itself is a deterministic placeholder, so a long run is shortened into a text that says nothing. Both reference harnesses summarise with a model call, keep a tail of the recent conversation, and separately prune the outputs of old tools. This wave replaces the placeholder with the call and adds the pruning.
checks: ./scripts/dev ert tests/unit/test-yeah-state.el tests/unit/test-yeah-loop.el tests/unit/test-yeah-tools.el tests/unit/test-yeah-perm.el tests/unit/test-yeah-session.el tests/unit/test-yeah-compact.el tests/unit/test-yeah-undo.el tests/unit/test-yeah-acp.el tests/unit/test-yeah-emcp.el tests/unit/test-yeah-gptel.el tests/unit/test-yeah-subagent.el tests/unit/test-yeah-shell.el tests/unit/test-yeah-codes.el
objection: Compaction by a model call costs tokens and a turn, and the harness is compacting precisely when the context is tight and the model is expensive.
refuted_by: A compaction whose summary is worse than the records it replaced. If the run continues worse after the compaction than before it, the feature is a loss.
